description: Client slice: the two hooks, the pure geometry module, the presentational chart + range selector, the barrel export, and the Portfolio tab integration, all with unit/render tests. Depends on FEAT-001 for the src/types/db.ts RPC entry (the useBackfillPortfolioHistory hook calls supabase.rpc('backfill_portfolio_snapshots') and must type-check). Built exactly per design.md §4-§9.
steps: Create src/features/portfolio/use-portfolio-history.ts mirroring src/features/trading/use-bars.ts (design §4): export type ChartRange = '1M'|'3M'|'1Y'|'5Y'|'ALL'; RANGE_DAYS for the four non-ALL ranges (1M 31, 3M 93, 1Y 366, 5Y 1827); interface PortfolioHistoryPoint { snapDate; equityCents; cashCents; positionsValueCents }; portfolioHistoryQueryKey(range) => ['portfolio-history', range] as const; pure rangeCutoffDate(range, now = new Date()) returning null for 'ALL' and UTC-derived YYYY-MM-DD otherwise; fetchPortfolioHistory(range) selecting 'snap_date, equity_cents, cash_cents, positions_value_cents' from portfolio_snapshots ordered snap_date ascending, applying .gte('snap_date', cutoff) only when cutoff is non-null, mapping rows to camelCase points, passing no user id; usePortfolioHistory(range, enabled = true) via useQuery with no refetchInterval.

Create src/features/portfolio/use-portfolio-history.test.ts: assert rangeCutoffDate against a fixed UTC clock (e.g. new Date('2025-06-15T12:00:00Z')) returns the exact YYYY-MM-DD for 1M/3M/1Y/5Y computed as now - RANGE_DAYS[range], and null for 'ALL' (AC-14).

Create src/features/portfolio/use-backfill-portfolio-history.ts mirroring src/features/trading/use-place-order.ts (design §5): export type BackfillErrorCode = 'not_authenticated'|'no_account'; a BACKFILL_ERROR_MESSAGES map + fallback; mapBackfillError(error) structured identically to mapPlaceOrderError; backfillResultSchema = z.number().int().nonnegative(); backfillPortfolioHistory() calling supabase.rpc('backfill_portfolio_snapshots') with no args, throwing on error, returning backfillResultSchema.parse(data); useBackfillPortfolioHistory() using useMutation<number, Error, void> that on success invalidates ['portfolio-history'] and PORTFOLIO_QUERY_KEY (import from ./use-portfolio). Export mapBackfillError and backfillPortfolioHistory for tests.

Create src/features/portfolio/use-backfill-portfolio-history.test.ts: assert mapBackfillError maps not_authenticated / no_account / unknown to the expected copy (mirror the mapPlaceOrderError test), and backfillResultSchema accepts a non-negative int and rejects a non-number (AC-15).

Create src/features/portfolio/components/chart-geometry.ts mirroring src/features/trading/components/chart-geometry.ts with a neutral point shape (design §6): interfaces EquityPoint { snapDate; valueCents }, ChartPoint, ChartLayout, ValueDomain; functions valueDomain (null for empty, widen +/-1 when all values equal), valueToY (axis flip + clamp, padding clamped to 1/4 smaller dimension), indexToX (even spread, single-point centred), equityToPoints, pointsToPolyline (round to 1 decimal). No trade-marker code.

Create src/features/portfolio/components/chart-geometry.test.ts mirroring the trading chart-geometry.test.ts: known-series domain, flat-series +/-1 fallback, single-point centring, empty-series [], polyline string (AC-16).

Create src/features/portfolio/components/range-toggle.tsx as a structural clone of src/features/trading/components/range-toggle.tsx (design §8): export PORTFOLIO_CHART_RANGES = ['1M','3M','1Y','5Y','ALL'] as const; tablist View, each option a Pressable with accessibilityRole='tab', accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}, accessibilityLabel={`Range ${range}`}; active tab backgroundColor theme.colors.primary with Text color='onPrimary', inactive 'transparent' with color='textMuted'. Import ChartRange from ../use-portfolio-history.

Create src/features/portfolio/components/portfolio-value-chart.tsx (design §7): presentational, data-via-props only (NO supabase import). Props { points: readonly EquityPoint[]; range: ChartRange; height?: number (default 200); loading?: boolean; empty?: boolean }. Mirror src/features/trading/components/line-chart.tsx: self-measure width via onLayout, <Polyline> for >1 point, <Circle> for exactly 1 point, muted 'No chart data yet' for empty or 0 points, loading placeholder when loading. Header summary: current equity = last point valueCents via formatCents; change = last - first via formatSignedCents; percent via formatPercent(pctChange(last, first)); tint primary (gain) / danger (loss) / textMuted (flat) with the sign in the accessibility label (mirror PortfolioSummary gainColor/gainText). A 'Paper money' tag like PortfolioSummary. accessibilityRole='image' with label `Portfolio value, ${range}`. Import ChartRange from ../use-portfolio-history and the geometry helpers/EquityPoint from ./chart-geometry.

Modify src/features/portfolio/components/index.ts: export { PortfolioValueChart, type PortfolioValueChartProps } from './portfolio-value-chart' and export { RangeToggle, PORTFOLIO_CHART_RANGES } from './range-toggle'. Do NOT export ChartRange from the barrel (design N3) — consumers import it from ../use-portfolio-history.

Create src/features/portfolio/components/portfolio-value-chart.test.tsx (jest-expo + test-renderer, as the trading component tests do): assert the empty copy for empty, a <Polyline> for >=2 points, a <Circle> for 1 point, and the gain/loss color + accessibility sign (AC-16, AC-17).

Modify app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx (the only edit under app/, design §9): in PortfolioView add const [range, setRange] = useState<ChartRange>('3M'); call usePortfolioHistory(range) and useBackfillPortfolioHistory(). Render a chart card in the header block ABOVE PortfolioSummary containing PortfolioValueChart (points mapped from the history query) and the portfolio RangeToggle. Treat history.data.length <= 1 as sparse: show a 'Your portfolio history will build over time' card (not a one-dot chart); when backfill.isError render mapBackfillError(backfill.error) as a muted caption; while backfill.isPending render a 'Building your history...' caption. Fire the backfill at most once per mount with a useRef latch set before mutate(), guarded by (!history.isLoading && sparse && !firedRef.current && !backfill.isPending) in a useEffect keyed to [history.isLoading, sparse, backfill.isPending]. A brand-new account still <= 1 point after refetch keeps the empty state. Leave PortfolioSummary, the trade-history/Stress Lab buttons, the holdings FlatList, the empty state, the Disclaimer, and the Gate unchanged. Import ChartRange from ../../src/features/portfolio/use-portfolio-history.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test` passes including the new tests: use-portfolio-history.test.ts (AC-14), use-backfill-portfolio-history.test.ts (AC-15), chart-geometry.test.ts (AC-16), portfolio-value-chart.test.tsx (AC-16/AC-17).
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes: supabase.rpc('backfill_portfolio_snapshots') and the ['portfolio-history', range] key type-check (AC-13); ChartRange is imported from the hook module, not the barrel.

PortfolioValueChart imports no Supabase client (data via props only); the range selector exposes 1M/3M/1Y/5Y/ALL and marks the active option selected; app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx is the only changed file under app/.
git diff shows package.json and package-lock.json unchanged and no new charting-library import (AC-22).
verification: npm test                (full Jest suite green, including the four new test files)

device/simulator pass (NOT automatable): AC-18 live range refetch+redraw, AC-19 curve renders at 3M with existing content intact, AC-20 sparse card + once-per-mount backfill then curve, AC-21 brand-new account keeps empty state
findings:
IMPLEMENTED the full client slice per design §4-§9. New files under src/features/portfolio/: use-portfolio-history.ts (+test), use-backfill-portfolio-history.ts (+test), components/chart-geometry.ts (+test), components/range-toggle.tsx, components/portfolio-value-chart.tsx (+test). Barrel components/index.ts exports PortfolioValueChart/PortfolioValueChartProps + RangeToggle/PORTFOLIO_CHART_RANGES (ChartRange intentionally NOT exported from the barrel per N3). app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx wires the chart card above PortfolioSummary with range state (default '3M'), the sparse '<= 1 point' card, the once-per-mount backfill latch, and the pending/error captions.

VERIFICATION (all from the worktree root): `npm test` green = 132 suites / 2614 tests, including the four new files (use-portfolio-history.test.ts AC-14, use-backfill-portfolio-history.test.ts AC-15, chart-geometry.test.ts AC-16, portfolio-value-chart.test.tsx AC-16/17). `npx tsc --noEmit` passes (supabase.rpc('backfill_portfolio_snapshots') and the ['portfolio-history', range] key type-check, AC-13). `npx expo lint` clean. `git diff --stat package.json package-lock.json` shows NO change (NFR-1 / AC-22 held; react-native-svg reused, no new import).

ONE EXTRA FILE CHANGED beyond the planned set: __tests__/portfolio-screen-test.tsx. The existing portfolio-screen test renders PortfolioScreen, which now mounts usePortfolioHistory/useBackfillPortfolioHistory; without a QueryClientProvider those hooks throw. Mirroring the test's existing mock style, I added jest.mock stubs for the two new hook modules (history defaults to sparse so the summary assertions stay unambiguous) and added 3 integration tests (sparse card + once-per-mount backfill AC-20; multi-point chart renders AC-19; mapped backfill-error caption FR-4.3). This was required to keep the suite green; it is a test-only change, no runtime file beyond the planned set.

TEST NOTE for reviewers: in this jest-expo setup `render()` from @testing-library/react-native (v14) is async and the onLayout width measurement only applies after awaiting; the component test fires a synthetic 'layout' event then uses `await findByTestId('portfolio-value-line'|'portfolio-value-dot')`. The chart's <Polyline>/<Circle> carry those testIDs for the render assertions.

OUTSTANDING device/simulator checks (NOT automatable, deferred to integration/review on a device): AC-18 (live range refetch + redraw across 1M/3M/1Y/5Y/ALL), AC-19 (curve renders at 3M with existing portfolio content intact), AC-20 (sparse card then once-per-mount backfill then curve), AC-21 (brand-new account keeps the empty state after the backfill returns 0).
